cards.name: Shot
cards.text: Shoot a player you can reach. They lose 1 health unless they play Dodge.

cards.name: Dodge
cards.text: Play when you are shot to avoid losing health.

cards.name: Whiskey
cards.text: Gain 1 health, up to your maximum.

cards.name: Saloon
cards.text: Every player gains 1 health.

cards.name: Stagecoach
cards.text: Draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Express Wagon
cards.text: Draw 3 cards.

cards.name: General Store
cards.text: Reveal one card per player. Starting with you, each player takes one.

cards.name: Steal
cards.text: Take a card from a player at distance 1, from their hand or the table.

cards.name: Disarm
cards.text: Make any player discard a card from their hand or the table.

cards.name: Duel
cards.text: Challenge a player. Take turns playing Shot; the first who cannot loses 1 health.

cards.name: Ambush
cards.text: Every other player plays Shot or loses 1 health.

cards.name: Gatling
cards.text: Shoot every other player.

cards.name: Barrel
cards.text: When you are shot, draw a card. On a heart, the shot misses.

cards.name: Scope
cards.text: You see every other player at distance −1.

cards.name: Horse
cards.text: Other players see you at distance +1.

cards.name: Jail
cards.text: Put in front of another player. At the start of their turn they draw: unless it is a heart, they skip the turn.

cards.name: Dynamite
cards.text: At the start of your turn draw a card. On spades 2 to 9 you lose 3 health; otherwise pass it left.

cards.name: Pistol
cards.text: Range 1. You may play any number of Shot cards on your turn.

cards.name: Revolver
cards.text: Range 2.

cards.name: Rifle
cards.text: Range 3.

cards.name: Carbine
cards.text: Range 4.

cards.name: Long Rifle
cards.text: Range 5.

cards.name: Mae Hartley
cards.text: When you play Whiskey, another player of your choice also gains 1 health.

cards.name: Silas Crane
cards.text: At the end of your turn, if you played no cards, draw 1 card.

cards.name: Tomasa Reyes
cards.text: You may play Dodge for a player sitting next to you.

cards.name: Old Hollis
cards.text: Draw one card fewer at the start of each of your turns.

cards.name: Wren Calloway
cards.text: You may put equipment into play face down. Turn it face up the first time you use it.

cards.name: Ezra Flint
cards.text: Players holding fewer cards than you cannot Dodge your Shots.

cards.name: Clem Shaw
cards.text: Once per turn, you may swap a card in your hand with a face-up equipment card in front of you.

cards.name: The Parson
cards.text: Whenever any player gains health from Whiskey, you may draw 1 card.
